# 💄 Hair/Makeup Artists

**Hair and Makeup Pricing for Studio Sessions**\
Hair and makeup is $300 and charged at the time of booking if the client chooses to book it. They will pay tip to the artist at the shoot before their artist leaves. This is generally payable via Venmo.\


**How Clients Book Hair/Makeup**\
In the (our public Sprout booking link that shows multiple different kinds of sessions they can chose from), clients will see separate session types for session types that have the option for hair and makeup (only Power Hour sessions and Standard Sessions) - one that includes hair and makeup, and one without. They can select the option that works best for them. Based on their selection, the correct amount of time will be reserved on our calendar to include both the session and time for hair/makeup if they booked that. They will also be charged for hair and makeup when booking if they decided they wanted that.\
\
&#xNAN;_&#x4E;ote: in-studio hair/makeup services are not offered for In-and-Out Sessions. It will be offered for dating profile photo sessions once we begin to offer those as their own standalone session type._\
\
\
**Adding Hair/Makeup After Booking**\
If a client decides to add hair and makeup after booking a session without it, we can check if there’s time to fit it in before their scheduled shoot. Hair and makeup can only begin at the start of our business hours for that day, and their session has to wrap up by the end of business hours for that day.

_Example Scenario_\
_If a client’s session is at 11a and our business hours begin at 10a, we can’t add hair/makeup beforehand without adjusting their session time. Hair/makeup takes 1.5 hours (though it can sometimes be shorter depending on their needs), so we’d need to move the session to 11:30a to allow for hair/makeup to start at 10a._

\
**Scheduling Considerations**\
This becomes more complex if there’s another shoot booked that day.

* Power-Hour Sessions are 1 hour long and require a 30-minute buffer afterward.
* Standard Sessions are scheduled for up to 2.5 hours and also require a 30-minute buffer.\
  So, a Standard Session with hair/makeup would take up to 4.5 hours total:\
  1.5 hours for hair/makeup + 2.5 hours for the session + 30-minute buffer.

If hair/makeup starts at 10a and the session begins at 11:30a, we’d finish around 2p and need to avoid scheduling another session until 2:30p. If another session is already booked at, say, 1:30p, we’d either need to move the first client to a different day or see if they’re available later.

\
**What’s Usually Easiest**\
It’s generally easier to add hair/makeup to a Power-Hour Session than to a Standard Session, since it requires less time overall. The exception is if no other sessions are booked that day—in that case, adding hair/makeup to any session is typically doable.\


**Hair and Makeup Contracts**\
If a client adds hair and makeup, we’ll manually send them a second contract to complete. We have different templates for each artist we work with. The artist provides the contract content, and we send it on their behalf. These contracts also include a few basic questions we’d typically include in a questionnaire—such as whether the client has any allergies or sensitivities to hair or makeup products, etc.\
\
We forward the signed contract to the artist so they can come to the session prepared, and so they can save it for their records. \
